departureMessages.section.title: Scheduled messages
departureMessages.section.description: Send a template to everyone on a departure a number of days before or after it, each person with their own pickup point and time. Messages go through the Communication Hub and respect opt-outs and your message allowance.
departureMessages.section.tourDescriptio: A rule added here applies to this tour's departures only. It replaces the agency rule with the same name, and an inactive rule switches that agency rule off for this tour.
departureMessages.loadFailed: Could not load the scheduled messages
departureMessages.adminOnly: You can read the rules here. Changing them needs the permission to edit departures.

departureMessages.empty.description: Add a rule, for example the pickup time two days before departure at 18:00.
